facts.fact: The Universal Service Fund, administered by the Communications Authority, funded the Digital Superhighway backbone and metro fibre procurement (tenders expected to cost over Sh15 billion per the petitioner), and a 1 October 2024 Attorney-General advisory was relied on by the CA in processing payments; the document does not name the law assigning the fund, and the High Court quashed the advisory on 2026-09-04 but did not nullify the contracts.
